_metadata.description: Chemical groups measured to block an EMC build, with the per-field failure rate each was measured at. Used by forcefield.select_by_moiety to decide WHETHER to probe, never to decide the force field: a match narrows the search, a real EMC trial build decides.
_metadata.source: docs/ff_coverage_sweep/{arm0,arm1}.jsonl -- real EMC trial builds at dp=4, nchains=2 over all 982 EMC-routed polymers in RadonPy's PI1070.
_metadata.how_to_read_blocks: `tried` counts trial builds of matching monomers against that field across both arms; the class prior (arm0) sees every match, the alternatives (arm1) see only arm0's failures. A fail_rate at or near 1.00 for EVERY field means no cascade can rescue these -- probe the prior once to catch the false positives, then refuse.
_metadata.coverage_gap: These rules match 266 of the 347 measured failures (77%). The remainder -- chiefly missing torsion rows -- has no compact structural signature yet, so a SMILES matching no rule is UNSCREENED, not cleared.

moieties.label: amide / imide / urea / urethane nitrogen
moieties.note: EMC perceives this N as SP3 and types it PCFF `na` ("sp3 nitrogen in amines"). The published carbonyl rows belong to `n` ("generic sp2 nitrogen (in amids)"), so the {na, c_1} bond increment does not exist and typing stops. `na` is CORRECT for a real amine -- PIMN builds 11/11 -- so the rule must require the adjacent C=O, not just an N. Nine template variants were tried and all lost to `na`: the perception is upstream, in the EMC binary, not in a table this repo can patch. DELIBERATELY ALIPHATIC: uppercase N/C in SMARTS do not match an atom RDKit aromatized, so a five-membered aromatic imide is NOT matched. That exclusion is measured, not an oversight -- widening to [#7;X3][#6;X3]=[#8;X1] adds 58 matches of which only 21 fail (31 aromatic-imide PIMD members build), dropping precision 0.97 -> 0.86. Aromatic imides remain UNSCREENED.

moieties.label: nitro group
moieties.note: No EMC field carries a typing rule for the hypervalent/charge-separated nitro nitrogen.

moieties.label: phosphoryl / phosphazene P=O
moieties.note: No EMC field carries the P=O bond increment. Appears in PIMD and PVNL members and NOT in PPHS, the polyphosphazene class -- the clearest single case of chemistry crossing the class taxonomy.
